title: Analytics

description.platform: Dashboard usage by area and route, without personal data. Off by default until the LGPD review (D-PA-06).
description.partner: Your brand's own identifier, optional, for the login and /app of your customers.

readOnly: Read only: the managers of this level edit it.
lgpd: Depends on the legal LGPD review (D-PA-06). Keep it off until it is approved.

platform.title: Product analytics
platform.description: The platform picks the provider and the site identifier. The CSP allows only the chosen provider's domain, and only while analytics is on.

provider.label: Provider
provider.posthog: PostHog (keeps an identifier, asks for consent)

site.label: Site identifier
site.hint: Plausible: the site domain registered there (e.g. panel.example.com). PostHog: the project's public key (phc_...).

rules.title: What is sent
rules.description: Fixed rules, the same for the platform and the partners.
rules.data: Only the area of the screen (platform, admin, app, login) and the route with its variable parts replaced by :id.
rules.never: Never: e-mail, ids of people or records, workspace name, tokens, query string, title or content of the screen.
rules.consentPosthog: PostHog keeps an anonymous identifier in the browser: nothing is sent before the person consents.
rules.consentPlausible: Plausible uses no cookie and keeps no identifier: no consent notice is needed. With PostHog, nothing is sent without consent.
rules.debug: Outside production, each event also shows in the browser console.
rules.events: Planned product events (name only, no properties)

partner.title: Your brand's analytics
partner.description: Uses the platform's provider. Measures the login and /app of your customers, with the same consent and data rules.
partner.platformOffHint: The platform has analytics off: nothing is sent, not even to your identifier.

consent.title: Usage measurement
consent.description: May we measure which screens are used to improve the dashboard?
consent.noPersonalData: Only the area and route of the screen, no personal data. You may decline.

errors.plausibleSite: Enter the site domain at Plausible.
errors.siteRequired: Enter the identifier before turning it on.
